newsitem.title: UK: MOTOR RACING-TYRRELL SIGN JAPANESE HOPE TAKAGI.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-TYRRELL SIGN JAPANESE HOPE TAKAGI.

text.p: The Tyrrell motor racing team have signed Japanese Toranosuke Takagi as their test driver for the 1997 Formula One season.
"I am convinced he has a great future ahead of him in Formula One. His appointment is with a view to becoming a team driver from 1998," team boss Ken Tyrrell said at a news conference in Tokyo.
Takagi added: "I am delighted to get this chance. It will help me to develop my talents ready to race for Tyrrell in 1998 and beyond."

Tyrrell also announced renewed links with Satoru Nakajima, his former driver and the first Japanese competitior in formula one. Now head of his own market consultancy company, he will join the Tyrrell board as sporting director.

He said the team had a new sponsorship deal with the Japanese component and accessory manufacturer PIAA while construction of the new Tyrrell Ford 025 challenger was on schedule and the car should begin testing early next year.
